TC-14/S05.title: Save & Extract outcome table on the live model: matched, unmatched, still pending, restated, conditional, monitoring, retraction, given medication, bedside check, action item
TC-14/S05.detail: Dataset gen-journeys v2 on dev (live Haiku 4.5, numeric task ids; v1 with the matrix's 't-…' ids could close nothing), one Save & Extract per mode through the app's UI. Both modes: C1 'BMP came back' closed 'Follow up BMP' and C2 'PT saw her' closed 'PT eval' (passed); C3 'Wound care consult' stayed open; C8 one urine-culture task; C5 no glargine task and the glargine row unchanged; C6 no metoprolol task (Hospital: row resumed with today's change); C11 one weight task, still open. FAILED: C10 — 'Blood cultures still pending' CLOSED 'Follow up blood cultures' in both modes (a false close; message '✓ Tasks updated — 3 completed …'); C4 / C9 — the conditional diet order and 'monitor her potassium daily' did not become tasks in either mode (known D4: the extraction prompt excludes them, waiting on Vikram). Recorded: 'Check for dysuria this afternoon' became a task in both modes (Q3); Nursing Home metoprolol still Held after Save & Extract (Q13).
TC-14/S05.productIssue: Saying 'blood cultures still pending' closes the 'Follow up blood cultures' task, so a result the physician still has to check drops off the open task list; conditional and monitoring orders are not turned into tasks (D4).
